title: sample id
name: sample_id
description: Unique sample ID
comments: Unique identifier assigned to each sampler prior to deployment. The ID should remain unchanged throughout sample collection and analysis.

title: sample type
name: sample_type
description: Type of sampler deployed
comments: Indicates the type of sampler used for sample collection. Values should correspond to the predefined sampler categories.

title: room id
name: room_id
description: Room ID assigned in the field
comments: Identifier used to designate the room or location where the sampler was deployed. Should match the room naming convention used for the site.

title: materials
name: materials
description: Specific material, surface, matrix etc. that was sampled
comments: Describes the material, surface, or matrix from which the sample was collected. Use consistent terminology across samples.

title: school id
name: school_id
description: Unqiue school ID
comments: Identifier assigned to each school or building included in the study. Should be consistent across all sampling rounds.

title: sampling round
name: sampling_round
description: The sampling round associated with each sample for a school
comments: Indicates the sampling event or campaign sequence for the school. Used to distinguish repeated measurements collected over time.

title: remediation
name: remediation
description: Indicates if the sampler was deployed before or after remediation was performed on the material
comments: Specifies whether sample collection occurred before or after remediation activities associated with the sampled material.

title: sampling start date
name: sampling_start_date
description: Sampler deployment start date
comments: Date on which the sampler was deployed in the field. Represents the beginning of the sampling period.

title: sampling end date
name: sampling_end_date
description: Sampler deployment collection/end date
comments: Date on which the sampler was retrieved or sampling was completed. Represents the end of the sampling period.

title: remendiation method
name: remendiation_method
description: Describes how the material was remediated
comments: Describes the remediation approach or treatment applied to the sampled material prior to or following sampling. Use standardized terminology when possible.

title: tPCB
name: tPCB
description: total PCBs, sum of all 209 PCB congeners
comments: Total PCB concentration calculated as the sum of all measured PCB congeners. Values should be reported using the units specified for the study.
